author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Voruna Prime access trailer for Warframe, the hit third-person action co-op shooter developed by Digital Extremes. Brutal, bestial, and burnished in Orokin Gold, this is Voruna more feral than ever. Pouncing into Prime Access on April 8 to satiate her boundless bloodlust, she vaults into venery alongside her signature Prime weapons and exclusive Prime accessories. Gain instant access to her full complement of Prime equipment for a limited time and lead the hunt with this untamable wolven queen.
title: Warframe - Official Voruna Prime Access Trailer (Red Band Trailer)

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for Impurity, a dark fantasy colony survival RPG developed by 
Incurso Studios. Lead your people in a harsh world where survival depends on faith, power, and the choices you make. Build and grow your settlement, recruit companions, explore dangerous lands, and confront ancient forces lurking beneath the world. Impurity is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Impurity - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the launch trailer for Blastroid, an arcade-style, fast-paced roguelite game developed by 
Bedirhan Cakir. Weave through incoming fire with skill as you unleash chaos across the battlefield. Upgrade your ship with enhanced engines, striking effects, and powerful boosts. Level up, collect items, combine your weapons, and blast enemies! Blastroid is available now on PC (Steam).
title: Blastroid - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Kenshiro from Fist of the North Star joins the City of the Wolves Season 2 roster! The legendary fighter descends on South Town in June 2026.
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves × Fist of the North Star: Kenshiro - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Where Winds Meet Hexi Expansion Chapter 2: Liangzhou gameplay trailer for the second chapter of the Wuxia open-world action-adventure RPG. Where Winds Meet's Hexi Expansion Chapter 2: Liangzhou will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Steam, Epic Games Store, Windows PC, the Apple App Store, and Google Play on April 2, 2026.

Where Winds Meet is an epic Wuxia open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China at the tenth century. You will assume the role of a young sword master as they embark on a journey to uncover the mysteries of their own identity. Let the wind carry your legend on an epic journey to the East!
title: Where Winds Meet - Official Hexi Expansion Chapter 2: Liangzhou Gameplay Trailer
